caption: The drawing, rendered in fine pencil or ink on a beige or light tan background, depicts three technical views of a wooden armchair labeled as "Arm Chair, Sewall House, Brooklyn Museum" in the upper right corner. The "Top View" shows the outline of the seat, which is trapezoidal with rounded front corners, measuring 22.5 inches across the front and 15.75 inches at the back, divided into sections with linear and hatched shading on the right side for detail. The "Front View" presents the chair's front elevation, revealing turned and ornamented front legs and arms, four horizontal back slats with curved shaping, and a boxed seat assembly with side stretchers at the bottom. The "Side View" displays the chair's profile, including the arm supports, the arrangement of five horizontal rails (three of which are at seat height or below), as well as the turned details of the rear legs; dimension notations are marked throughout for precision. The entire layout is drawn with careful measurement marks, right-angle guides, and neat, legible labels, using fine dark lines on a monochromatic, light background.
title: Armchair
